Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Jagged Lines Throw Blanket - 60 x 50 Inch, Tonal Blue
Colors: Tonal Blue
Imported The fun pattern, tonal blue coloring, and twisted fringe of this throw blanket can add cool style to any indoor space. A cotton-acrylic blend, this throw is comfortable as well as stylish. 60"L x 50"W Twisted, self tassels 1 throw blanket For best results, dry-clean. This throw can be washed on delicate cycle and line dried. Supersoft to the touch
